sec: ABG methodology: equipment and prerequisites · p826

items.q: Match the ABG equipment list — 1) 1 ml syringe with needle  2) Antiseptic  3) Personal protection … A) Gloves and cover roll  B) 0.5 ml heparinized, without excess heparin in the syringe  C) 70% alcohol wipe and gauze
items.exp: Equipment: ABG analyzer; 1 ml syringe with needle (0.5 ml heparinized — do not leave excess heparin within the syringe); 70% alcohol wipe and gauze; gloves and cover roll. (Book p826)

items.q: Regarding the heparin in the ABG syringe, the chapter instructs:
opts: Use 0.5 ml heparinized syringe and do not leave excess heparin within it
Use a dry syringe and add heparin only after sampling
Fill the syringe completely with heparin before sampling
Use 2 ml of heparin and leave it in the syringe
items.exp: A 0.5 ml heparinized syringe is specified, with the instruction not to leave excess heparin within the syringe. (Book p826)

items.q: For a valid sample, the syringe should contain more than what proportion of blood?
items.exp: Pre-requisite: the syringe should have > 50% of blood. (Book p826)

items.q: The syringe size recommended for ABG sampling is:
items.exp: Pre-requisite: syringe should be 3 ml or less; it should also hold > 50% blood with no air bubbles. (Book p826)

items.q: Match the pre-requisites of ABG sampling — 1) Air bubbles  2) Their effect  3) Cold chain … A) Must be maintained during transport  B) Should not be present  C) ↑PO₂ and ↓PCO₂
items.exp: The sample should not contain air bubbles because they raise PO₂ and lower PCO₂, and the cold chain must be maintained. (Book p826)

items.q: ‘Air bubbles in an ABG syringe raise the PCO₂ and lower the PO₂ of the sample.’
opts: False — air bubbles change only the pH
True, but only after 30 minutes of delay
items.exp: Air bubbles are listed as a pre-requisite violation because of ↑PO₂ and ↓PCO₂ in the sample. (Book p826)

items.q: A colleague collects an ABG into a 5 ml syringe filled to one-third, with visible bubbles. How many printed pre-requisites are broken?
opts: Three — syringe size, > 50% blood and no air bubbles
Two — syringe size and air bubbles only
None — all three parameters are acceptable
items.exp: The printed pre-requisites are: > 50% blood, syringe 3 ml or less, no air bubbles, and maintenance of the cold chain — so this sample breaks three of them. (Book p826)

items.q: All but one of the following are listed as ABG equipment. Which is the odd one out?
items.exp: Equipment list: ABG analyzer, 1 ml heparinized syringe with needle (0.5 ml heparinized), 70% alcohol wipe and gauze, gloves and cover roll. (Book p826)
